nativeBoundary.stalePolicy: Reject the captured action when any recorded identity or coordinate-unit fact differs, then reanalyze current text.

comparisonContract.originalDiagnostic: Every candidate starts from one MQ3001_UnknownColumn Bind diagnostic for Naem and exactly one structured Name replacement edit.
comparisonContract.coordinateBinding: The harness records the original query, digest, document id, wrapper version, coordinate unit, and native TextEdit together.
comparisonContract.beforeWithinAfter: Text changed before the edit span, inside the faulty token, and after the edit span must not be repaired by the captured action.
comparisonContract.sameLength: A changed document with the same length must be rejected by digest rather than trusted by offset coincidence.
comparisonContract.wrapperVersion: Unchanged text with a different wrapper version is stale under the consumer contract and is reanalyzed instead of silently applying the old action.
comparisonContract.reanalysis: Rejected actions produce no applied text and trigger analysis of the current document; current valid text succeeds and current invalid text retains its diagnostic.
comparisonContract.nativeContract: The test must not add document identity or coordinate fields to Musoq's native action or text-edit types.

revisionHistory.reason: The first replay exposed that an edit replacing Naem with the already-present Name is idempotent; the generic assertion that every stale application must change text was narrowed to cases where offset-only application would alter current text.
